name: Final Integration Testing & Production Readiness

tasks.content: Simulate complete voice interactions using Tavus testing tools or mocks. Verify utterance → tool invocation → UI rendering pipeline.
Use JMeter or k6 to simulate multiple concurrent sessions. Monitor SSE stream stability and memory usage under load.
Ensure only authenticated Tavus calls reach Edge Function. Validate inputs to prevent injection attacks and enforce rate limiting.
Manual testing with screen readers (VoiceOver, NVDA). Confirm ARIA announcements, focus order, and 0 Axe violations.
Deploy to Vercel production environment. Verify Vienna region latency <150ms and all environment variables are properly configured.
Final configuration of Tavus persona with minimal system prompt and get_assistant_response tool pointing to production Edge Function.

research_topics: Load testing best practices for SSE streams
